author: Exotic
body:
Hey Guys,
I have joined this awesome server about 5 months ago and I have some very positive feedback!

This server is very action packed with intense minecraft pvp. I think it is very good for finding friends, playing mc, and having fun.

Suggestions: I think you could add a fun gamemode I like to call Capture The Flag :D. 

Make it like nebula, just that the objective is to capture the flag. I personally think this would be fun and awesome. :D

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Capture The Wool/Flag... Good memories. Used to be on of Nebula's gamemodes.

They removed it unfortunately and they have no plans on adding it back. CTW is what made Rendezvous 2 an awesome map. The DTM version is still good, but... *sigh*
